supplemental_question.question: For every patient represented in the supplied collection, report the number of eligible patient-present therapy sessions, distinct therapy days, and therapy minutes for January 5–30, 2026, separately by patient. Preserve any unresolved alternatives and cite supporting sources.

method: One completed cold trial per strategy plus exact-answer offline replays, using the same six questions, model, effort and unchanged source hashes. The successful lazy cold trial followed credit replenishment and started with an empty application database. Earlier failed/partial attempts are retained separately. A second offline lazy replay regenerated citation display after a rendering fix, without additional API calls or changed source citations; tables use that latest replay.
limitations: One completed cold trial per strategy, plus earlier failed or partial lazy attempts; order, network variation, API prompt caching and model variability affect results.
Cold means an empty application database; provider-side prompt caching is not controlled.
Supplied documents contain one chart patient; the collection question does not measure multi-patient scale.
Eager uses a clinical schema and Python arithmetic; lazy uses generic notes and model reasoning. This is a design comparison, not an isolated scheduling experiment or proof of equal accuracy.
No manually labeled answer benchmark is supplied; output disagreements need review.

Lazy required citation/quotation fixes and initially encountered exhausted API credits. Its completed cold run includes one failed citation-validation call followed by a successful bounded repair. Completed run status means all six questions produced outputs, not that all answers are unqualified: DEV-02, DEV-03 and BENCH-COLLECTION are partial.

quality_spotchecks: Both observed strategies report 12 sessions and 11 days, preserve Jan 26 as one encounter with 40/50-minute alternatives, and treat Jan 21 interrupted contact as one 45-minute encounter.

Eager incorrectly creates Casey, the partner, as a separate chart patient in its collection output. The completed lazy collection answer correctly identifies only Rowan and reports 12 sessions, 11 days and 585–595 minutes.

Lazy derives 60 group minutes on Jan 19, or 90 minutes for the day, from the scheduled session window, corrected attendance and break. Eager leaves the group duration unknown. This requires review of the activity-window assumption, rather than establishing an indisputable arithmetic error.
Both eager and completed lazy PHQ-9 answers identify three distinct assessment occasions with scores 18, 14 and 10, treating the Jan 26 imported form as a copy of Jan 16.

Latest lazy answers DEV-02, DEV-03 and BENCH-COLLECTION are partial because of unresolved duration or coverage qualifications. Six completed question-processing steps do not imply six unqualified answers.
Lazy DEV-05 overstates that recent session material referenced by the Jan 16 review is not supplied; the supplied Jan 14 note is used elsewhere in its answer. This limitation is not fully supported.

A display-only fix converts XML citation markers only when they match the validated public citation list and suppresses unmatched private markup. Source-validated citation arrays are unchanged; complete claim-by-claim citation coverage is not established.
These are limited source-based spotchecks, not a hand-labeled accuracy benchmark.
